pages.text: Biotech machines are multiblocks. Build the structure shown in each machine entry exactly; the controller will only process recipes while the structure is valid.$(br)$(br)Once a matching recipe has its required inputs, enough energy, and room for its outputs, processing starts automatically.

Use JEI to inspect exact machine recipes, quantities, and outputs.$(br)$(br)For automation, connect pipes, cables, or inventories to the outward-facing side of each hatch. Input hatches accept resources; output hatches expose finished products for extraction.
